news.title: CQE partners Infleqtion and Cisco announce collaboration to advance networked quantum technology
news.summary_en: The collaboration brings together Infleqtion’s neutral-atom quantum computers and sensors with Cisco’s networking stack to accelerate scalable, distributed quantum computing

news.title: David Awschalom wins global Breakthrough of the Year award for interdisciplinary work in molecular and protein qubits
news.summary_en: Award by Berlin-based Falling Walls Foundation honors high-risk, multi-field leap across quantum, biology, and chemistry

news.title: Chicago Business Journal: How the Bloch's new operations chief Matthew Zajac aims to grow the local quantum scene
news.summary_en: The Bloch Quantum Tech Hub is building out its regional strategy, from the FaQtory supplier building at IQMP to expanded Midwest partnerships and a workforce pipeline through community colleges.

news.title: Helium lifts new quantum computing concept
news.summary_en: Breakthrough from a team led by Jacob Covey, associate professor in the University of Chicago’s Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering and Department of Physics, turns helium-3’s low mass into a quantum resource.
